uncertainty_notes: Range-keyed SWR for /api/products via buildDateRangeKey. Local range overrides global with X reset to global. Local store overrides global. Period bucketing (day/week/month/half_year/year) — isoWeek uses ISO 8601 algorithm. Date inputs auto-swap when from > to (or to < from) — same UX as Filters' applyFromCandidate. Asia/Jerusalem TZ for today + nowInIsrael. Today bucket forced into the list when in range, even with zero products. WR-06 degraded-path (200+error) surfacing. Per-bucket hasOrders/hasNet flags suppress empty columns. Live bucket gets pulse + nowLabel.
test_coverage_gaps: No tests for ProductsTable component or its aggregate() helper
No test for the isoWeek edge cases (year boundary, Jan 1 = ISO week 53 of previous year)
No test for the auto-swap range input behavior
